sentences.en: "How long will the renovation work last?" "About a fortnight."
sentences.zh: 装修工作要持续多久？“大约两个星期。”

sentences.en: We will proceed with the hearing on Wednesday fortnight.
sentences.zh: 我们将在下个周三举行听证会。

sentences.en: We are losing languages at a rate of one every fortnight.
sentences.zh: 我们平均每两个星期就会失去一种语言。
